Operations on THH of O-algebras
The goal of this section is to initiate the study of endomorphisms of THH viewed as a functor
AlgO(Catperf) →Sp, that is, to study the extra operations that arise on THH(C) when C
has a particular kind of multiplicative structure encoded by a one-colored ∞-operad O. Our
main result in this section is Theorem B.
As is clear from the statement of Theorem B, the case of endomorphisms of THH viewed
as a functor on AlgO(Catperf) is more subtle.
We first describe the general approach to this question, and then specialize to get the
precise results that we claimed.
